scope: two original failed experiments, original OOS fills and curve only; all history already seen

formula.overnight_reference: previous_gross_close_notional * arithmetic_mean(open / previous_close - 1) across original basket
formula.intraday_reference: post_fill_gross_open_notional * arithmetic_mean(close / open - 1) across original basket
formula.allocation_residual: actual overnight+intraday minus same-exposure equal-weight references
formula.nav_rounding_residual: actual NAV change minus overnight_actual minus intraday_actual plus cost

semantics: exact rational decomposition of a fixed realized model path, not executable equal-weight strategy or causal replay; intraday reference uses realized post-fill notional, not a predictive signal
